why: An open-air parking lot in Japantown, Westbrook, used by the street story sts_wbr_jpn_09 (a tier-3 fixer gig): a netrunner and a client, Walt Ozark, meet beside a parked Chevalier Thrax truck, and Militech fireteams wait at a parking spot, a street north of it and a street east of it to jump them on the way out. Vanilla streams the lot only while that story runs, and the story's closing phase deactivates the netrunner group, so in normal play the lot is bare asphalt. This proposal loads the venue's one quest prefab and restores the netrunner community whole - the netrunner leaning on a wall, Walt Ozark smoking on a chair and their Thrax truck - as a quiet off-grid job in the lot, and leaves the Militech ambush teams and the chase out.

open_questions: Walk into the lot from the street and confirm the netrunner scene is alive. The netrunner should be leaning on the wall smoking and Walt Ozark sitting on the chair by the parked Chevalier Thrax, both calm and on their spots.

Confirm the lot has no quest actors or leftovers. No Militech soldiers, no Chevalier Emperor blocking the lot, no chase car, no map pin and no chase trigger - and walking in must not start sts_wbr_jpn_09.

Check the proximity wait fires. The venue has no device of its own, so the anchor is the gun-shop screen 76 m east with a 90 m radius; approach the lot and confirm _prox is reached before the people are re-issued.

Walk the three former ambush spots and confirm they are ordinary street. The rooftop spot north of the lot, the street west of it and the street east of it should have no Militech fireteam standing around a car.

Confirm the lot geometry streams in correctly. The section is loaded only by this venue phase; check the lot floor, the chairs and wall by the truck and the netrunner spots are present with no holes or missing building geometry.
Look at the truck up close. It should read as a parked prop with no get-in prompt or quest interaction tied to the unfired gig.

communities.why: The whole netrunner community: the netrunner on a wall lean-back smoke spot, Walt Ozark sitting on a chair leaning forward with a cigarette, and their parked Chevalier Thrax truck. Vanilla switches the entire group on with entry None / phase None at the start of the street story; every human entry's initial phase is 'default', which the catalogue resolves to those two relaxed smoking/leaning spots. Activating it whole is vanilla's own form (rule 9a), and it is the venue's only non-combat group and its top-priority group under rule 11a.

proximity_wait.why: The venue declares no devices at all (catalogue devices [], sites.json site 422 device_count 0) and the catalogue record carries no anchor_candidates, so this is the nearest real device entity on the same level: a gun-shop display screen at (-452.2, 1449.7, 35.1), 76 m east of the netrunner spot and in the always-loaded exterior_-8_22_0_0 sector, so it always streams. The wait is widened to 90 m so it fires on the walk up to the lot from the street. Written as the full $/ path because the venue has no device of its own to use.
